fields.label: Title
fields.value: Alice pays Bob using a UTXO

fields.label: Scenario
fields.value: Alice's wallet selects spendable outputs, creates an input referencing them, creates a payment output to Bob, optionally creates change, signs the spend, and broadcasts it.

fields.label: Steps
value: Sign according to each input's script condition
Nodes validate and relay the transaction
A miner includes it in a valid block

fields.label: Caveats
value: The wallet does not contain the coins; the ledger tracks UTXOs.
A broadcast transaction is not yet confirmed.

record.title: Miner finds a block
record.scenario: A miner builds a candidate block and searches for a header hash below the current target.
steps: Select transactions from a mempool
Build a candidate block and coinbase transaction
Try nonce and other header variations
Double-hash the header with SHA-256
Check hash against target
Broadcast a successful candidate
Nodes independently validate it
caveats: Finding a valid hash is probabilistic and can require many attempts.
Other miners may find a competing block at nearly the same time.
